split_method: Sort all 50 context_id values by SHA256(stage_a_dataset_sha256 + "|" + context_id); first 30 train, next 10 validation, final 10 holdout.

model.state_embedding: StandardScaler then PCA fit on the 30 unique training context vectors only.
model.k_selection: minimum validation Brier independently for each model; ties choose smaller k

models.state_only: nearest contexts; average all action×lag failure outcomes within each neighbor context
models.state_plus_lag: nearest contexts; average all actions at the exact lag
models.state_plus_action: nearest contexts; average all lags for the exact action
models.direct_action_lag: nearest contexts; exact action and exact lag
models.action_lag_global: training-context mean for exact action and lag; no state

primary_falsifiers.action_conditioning_redundancy: Brier(state_plus_lag) - Brier(direct_action_lag) must be > 0 with context-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.
primary_falsifiers.lag_conditioning_redundancy: Brier(state_plus_action) - Brier(direct_action_lag) must be > 0 with context-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.
primary_falsifiers.remedy_set_recovery: On held-out remedy-divergent context×lag groups, direct mean Jaccard must exceed both state_plus_lag and state_only.

secondary_matched_risk_test.baseline: state_only predicted P(fail) for CONTINUE at lag 0
secondary_matched_risk_test.test: Among pairs with comparable baseline risk but different oracle feasible sets, measure whether predicted feasible sets also differ.

claim_boundary: This tests learnability of intervention-conditioned outcomes under one frozen Unitree G1 controller and MuJoCo model.
It does not establish physical non-viability for the robot under all controllers.
It does not test or fit a Terrynce Curve, recoverability margin, or domain-independent scalar.
No action, lag, perturbation, target, outcome rule, or Stage A oracle may be changed after this lock.
